thought.text: Root cause found: this machine has only **7.6 GiB RAM** with 8 cores — three Angular dev servers plus the 10-container Docker stack cause memory pressure (15-min load avg 98.57, OOM kills in dmesg). That's why the dev servers are flaky. The core installation is solid; let me verify all three frontends through the proxy while all are up.

reasoning_content:
Root cause identified: This machine only has 7.6 GiB of RAM, and running 3 Angular dev servers (each a Vite/NX process using over 1GB) plus the Docker stack causes OOM kills. The 15-minute load average (98.57!) indicates heavy resource contention. The "crash (code=0)" of boards is a manifestation of this — nohup'd node processes get killed by OOM (though normally they should die with SIGKILL, not code 0... actually, with OOM the process gets killed by a signal, but the earlier "code=0" might have been something different — either way, memory pressure is the root cause of the unstable dev server).

In other words, the full parallel operation of 3 dev servers in this constrained environment is unstable, but each individual dev server works (confirmed 200s from all three: app 200, cms 200 (before the outage), boards 200).

This is an environmental resource constraint (7.6GB RAM for 3 Angular dev servers + 10 Docker containers), not an installation error. The installation itself — following the guide, `just up` — completed: all infra is healthy, backend is built and healthy, data is seeded, all 3 dev servers built successfully and served content.

Now, let's run the final verification of all 3 dev servers through the proxy. To avoid OOM, we should be careful about how much we run at once. app (34237) and boards (38377) are up, and the new cms is building. Let's wait for cms and verify all 3 via the proxy.

Let's proceed efficiently: wait for the cms build (~90 seconds), then curl each frontend via the proxy. To save memory, do it in a single command.

action.command: sleep 150; echo "=== final verification: all three frontends via shared proxy $(date) ==="; for a in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp_$a.html -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 -H "Host: ${a}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1); size=$(wc -c < /tmp/resp_$a.html 2>/dev/null); echo "${a}.workspace.localhost -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}, ${size:-0} bytes"; done; echo "=== backend + keycloak via proxy ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api /health: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/health; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "keycloak /realms/swcode: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode
